excluded_predictor: The live 192-dimensional deterministic seeded HybridFusion is an untrained representation and is not a learned baseline predictor.

croma.normalization: per-image per-channel mean +/- 2 sample-standard-deviations, clip to [0,1]; constant channels become zero

probe.head: single linear layer followed by softmax for prediction
probe.feature_standardization: train-only mean/std folded into linear probe

test_protocol: Test examples, predictions, and metrics remain sealed during baseline training and all validation-only repair decisions; all frozen baseline ablations and the final selected configuration are scored in one final test event.
